description:
Create a 'Film Noir' style black-and-white studio lighting setup using an HDRI environment.

Your goal is to light the scene using *only* the provided HDRI file, rotated to a specific angle, and color-corrected to be monochromatic.

Steps:
1. Switch the World environment to use Nodes.
2. Add an Environment Texture node and load the file located at '/home/ga/assets/studio_small_09_1k.exr'.
3. Add Texture Coordinate and Mapping nodes to control the HDRI placement.
4. Set the Mapping Z-Rotation to 125 degrees to position the key light.
5. Add a Hue/Saturation node to the network and set Saturation to 0.0 to make the lighting purely black and white.
6. Render the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/noir_render.png'.
7. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/noir_setup.blend'.
